title: Capability Admission Result v1
description: Host-controlled admission evidence recording the evaluation outcome of compiled CapabilityPayloadV1 candidates against Registry v2 gates. Confers zero execution permission or direct authority.

schema_version.description: Semantic type identity. Distinct from compilation, evaluation, and capability schemas.

compilation_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this admission evidence to the upstream CAPABILITY_COMPILATION_RESULT-v1 instance.

candidate_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this admission evidence to the specific CapabilityPayloadV1 candidate evaluated.

admission_status.description: Terminal outcome of the Registry v2 admission pipeline traversal.

admission_timestamp.description: Deterministic ISO-8601 timestamp representing when admission evaluation occurred.

registry_gate_result.description: Closed enumeration of gate inspection outcomes from Registry v2 evaluation.

failure_reason_class.description: Categorized classification of admission failure. Enforced via conditional state rules.

bridge_identity.description: Identifier of the host admission routing subsystem responsible for gate interfacing.
